title: MyAstroBoard camera presets
description: Generated by scripts/build_equipment_presets.py from the rules it checks - do not edit. See docs/EQUIPMENT.md#presets.

built_in.description: Part of a smart telescope, not sold on its own: hidden from the preset pickers, weighs 0, reached through the telescope's bundle.

id.description: Unique snake_case id across every preset file.

label.description: Display name; becomes the item name.

manufacturer.description: Brand, exactly as the file is named after it.

resolution_h.description: Pixels down, in the orientation the device delivers its images (not resolution_height_px).

resolution_w.description: Pixels across, in the orientation the device delivers its images (not resolution_width_px).

sensor_height_mm.description: Must equal resolution_h x pixel_size_um / 1000 within 2 %.

sensor_width_mm.description: Must equal resolution_w x pixel_size_um / 1000 within 2 %.

source_url.description: The maker's official spec page every value comes from.

suggests_experience.description: Sorts the presets matching the user experience level first.

type.description: A preset code, not the form label (dslr_color and mirrorless_color are stored as CMOS Color).

weight_kg.description: For a smart telescope: the whole unit. A built-in item weighs 0.
